sentences.text:
Heard on Ia No. 400/2016 which is first application under
Section 389 (1) Cr.P.C. for suspension of execution of sentence.

The applicant has been convicted under Section 7(1) read with Section 16(1)(A)(I) Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo one year RI and fine of Rs. 1000/- and in default of payment of fine to suffer two months R.I. vide judgment dt.8.1.2016 passed by IInd Additional Sessions Judge Shajapur.

It is submitted that the applicant has been wrongly convicted by the learned Trial Court under 7(1) read with Section 16(1)(A)(I)
Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
It is submitted that the learned Trial Court has not properly appreciated the evidence and material available on record.
It is urged that applicant has not misused the liberty granted and there is no likelihood of early disposal of this revision, hence prayed for suspension of execution of sentence.
Prayer is opposed by the learned Counsel for the respondent/State.
Perused the record and judgment passed by the learned Trial Court.

Taking into consideration the submissions of learned Counsel for the parties and looking to the short sentence imposed on the applicant and the fact that final disposal of this revision is likely to take some time, hence without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, IA 400/2016, an application for suspension of jail sentence is hereby allowed.

The substantive jail sentence of the applicant is suspended subject to depositing the fine amount and furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs 50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand) only with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before this Court/Registry on 22.2.2016 and on all such other dates as may be fixed in this behalf.
Accordingly, the application (I.A.No. 400/2016) stands disposed off.
